column7: The bootstrap token (resolveBootstrapToken) and the Vault connector token (resolveVaultToken) are answered from config.Load's *_FILE boot snapshot through config.LookupSecretEnv, not by re-opening the file: a file removed or swapped after Load is never used (TestResolveVaultToken_AnsweredFromBootSnapshot). Class guard: TestNoLiveSecretenvLookupOfFileCapableVars (report-only first day).
